info.name: Foody Backend API
info.description: Foody — Single-restaurant food ordering backend (Express + Firebase). Base {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:5000 . Auth: Bearer {{idToken}} (mock customToken or test-token-{{uid}}). All bodies prefilled — Import → Update {{email}} → Run in order. Products/Categories/Restaurant/Offers are public reads; Products create/update & Orders status & Seed force require admin. Addresses & Orders require auth. Cart 200 client-persisted, Payments 501. Home aggregates restaurant+offers+categories+popular/recommended. Database seeded from frontend mock (8 products p1-p8, 6 categories, r1 Foody House, 2 offers). See docs/API.md. Updated 2026-09-03 v2: added 8→8 products, restaurant/offers/home/seed, product filters isPopular/isRecommended/isVeg.

request.description: Send Email OTP. Rate-limited 10/hr, cooldown 60s. Body: email (required), channel=email|sms (default email). OTP printed to backend console in dev/mock mode.

Verify OTP -> returns customToken + uid. Covers: success, INVALID_OTP (400), OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_ALREADY_USED/OTP_NOT_FOUND, OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED (429). On success this auto-saves {{customToken}}, {{uid}}, {{idToken}} (=customToken mock) and {{testToken}} (=test-token-uid). For real Firebase: exchange customToken via signInWithCustomToken() to get real ID token, then paste into {{idToken}}.

exec: try { const u = new URL(j.data.link); const t = u.searchParams.get("token"); if(t){ pm.collectionVariables.set("magicToken", t); console.log("Auto-saved magicToken:", t); } } catch(e){ console.log("link:", j.data.link); }

request.description: Generate 32-byte token, store sha256, TTL 15min, one-time. Redirect base comes from MAGIC_LINK_REDIRECT_URL. Dev returns link with ?token= ; prod masks.
Verify magic link via POST body {token}. Also test reuse (second call => 400 MAGIC_LINK_ALREADY_USED) and expired.

item.name: 10 — Orders (AUTH) — NEW

exec: if(j.success && j.data){ pm.collectionVariables.set("orderId", j.data.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("orderNumber", j.data.orderNumber); console.log("Saved orderId:", j.data.id, "orderNumber:", j.data.orderNumber); }

request.description: Create order. AUTH required. Body: items array required (productId, name, price, quantity, image optional), subtotal/deliveryFee/tax/discount/total numbers (defaults 0 if missing), paymentMethod cod|online (default cod), address object optional. Returns id + orderNumber (ORD-...).
List orders for authenticated user. AUTH required. Query ?limit=20 (default). Sorted by createdAt desc. Merges Firestore + memory fallback.
List with limit param. AUTH required.
Get single order by id. AUTH required. Checks ownership: userId must match or role admin. 404 if not found, 403 if forbidden for other user's order.

Update order status. AUTH + requireRole('admin'). Allowed statuses: pending, preparing, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled. 400 INVALID if status invalid, 404 if order not found, 403 if not admin.
Negative: empty items -> 400 BAD_REQUEST Items required.
Negative: invalid status enum -> 400 BAD_REQUEST.
Negative: missing Authorization -> 401 UNAUTHORIZED.

item.description: Orders require auth. Create, list, getById for owner; status update requires admin.

request.description: Trigger DB seed if collections empty (idempotent). Public for dev. Writes 8 products, 6 categories, 1 restaurant, 2 offers to Firestore if empty. In mock mode returns skippedReason.

Force reseed — requires admin role. Customer token → 403 FORBIDDEN. To test forced seed, promote user to admin via Firestore (role:admin) then retry with admin token.

item.description: Idempotent Firestore seeding from frontend mock. POST /seed public, POST /seed?force admin only.
